summary: Plan indicators, check project data and prepare decision-ready donor reports. Explore this five-day government and donor-funded project M&E course.
lede: Monitoring and evaluation for government and donor-funded projects connects project activities to evidence that can guide management decisions. For project officers, M&E staff and programme managers, the course covers mapping a Theory of Change, defining indicators, planning data collection and checking data quality, then using evaluation questions and findings to support project reviews and reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people responsible for project results, evidence and reporting across public programmes and donor-funded delivery. It suits foundation-level practitioners who need to organize indicators, verify reported data and turn review findings into manageable actions.
modules: Evaluation Questions and OECD DAC Criteria
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with project objectives, workplans or routine project reporting is useful. No statistical programming is required; exercises use Excel for basic indicator calculations and data checks.
